$comment: Single source of truth for Sabicars colour. Generates tokens.css (npm run tokens) and is validated by scripts/check-contrast.mjs, which fails the build on any illegible pair. Edit here, never in CSS.

gold.$comment: The brand. 500 is the existing Sabicars gold (#C9A84C), kept exact so the logo and the site agree. On dark it is the call to action; on light it is an accent only — gold text on white fails contrast at body sizes.

darkSurface.$comment: Luminance ladder with a warm undertone, so black reads as lacquer rather than dead grey. Neutralised in the 2026-09-26 design pass (less brown, so cards read as charcoal, not mud), each step the smallest that still clears the checker. Validated by the checker, not by eye.

focus.$comment: A dedicated token, never a border colour. Must clear 3:1 on every surface it can land on.

ink.$comment: Light-theme call to action: a near-black button with an ivory label, the convention of luxury marques.
